answer: One concrete defence is a stake-and-age bond: each new agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn reputation slowly through verified work, so one operator spinning up thousands of clones faces a cost that scales linearly with every fake identity. Like a ripple spreading across a dune field, honest activity compounds into trust while the gale of cheap clones loses momentum, because each clone still pays the same deposit and waits the same long ageing period before it can vote or claim rewards.
